latest Version 0.2.3 · [PAID] Duskport - Realistic City Map · BeamNG.drive 0.39.x 1 day ago
Activity update
Older Updates

(Verified Creator. Check my Patreon profile for confirmation.)

Duskport is a massive, long-term project inspired by the atmosphere of iconic American coastal cities. After 6 months of intensive development, the first stable Early Access build is now available.

Project Vision: The final map will feature a "Three Islands" concept (similar to the GTA IV layout), offering diverse urban environments, highways, and industrial zones.

Current Version (v0.1) Highlights:

  • Initial Urban Sector: A highly detailed section of the city is ready for exploration.

  • Content Creator Ready: Designed with cinematic angles and realistic lighting, perfect for high-quality videos and screenshots.

  • Active AI Traffic: Basic traffic paths are implemented for a living city feel (currently being refined).

  • 6 Months of Work
  • Custom License Plates

Development Status: The project is currently 10-15% complete. This is a long-term commitment with regular updates planned. Your support on Patreon directly fuels the creation of the remaining islands and districts.

Access & Updates: This is a Paid Early Access release. The full build and all future updates are available exclusively for my Patreon members.

More Updates Will Come in the Future.

Made by Johny Dark
